summary: Completed comprehensive testing of NEW grower submission fields: Country of Export, Irradiation status (is_irradiated, willing_to_irradiate), and Image upload. E2E form submission flow works correctly with 'Pending Admin Authorization' confirmation.

Test file /app/backend/tests/test_grower_new_fields.py covers: export_country field, is_irradiated Yes/No, willing_to_irradiate Yes/No, image upload (PNG/JPG/WebP), image optional, invalid format rejection, 30kg minimum with multipart, admin approve image transfer.
